findings.title: Generic LP verifier omits raw rational denominator admission
findings.status: reproduced by unchanged-source native probe in both overflow-check modes
findings.detail: Unlike the full Phi1 and form paths, generic Phi1Verifier performs comparisons/arithmetic on public BigRational inputs without rejecting zero denominators. BigRational::new_raw permits those values. Validate denominators before comparisons and add typed-refusal tests.
findings.limits: Synthetic 1x1 LP with BigRational::new_raw(1,0) panics in num-rational; panic is caught by the probe. No forged certificate or authority exploit claimed.

findings.title: Floating dual-boundary maximum can hide arithmetic NaN
findings.status: reproduced by unchanged-source native probe in both overflow-check modes
findings.detail: Finite d0 and dual values can overflow products to opposite infinities, summing to NaN in d0^T dual; fold(0,f64::max) discards NaN. The final finite scalar checks may therefore return a zero boundary defect. Check every intermediate residual/boundary entry before reductions.
findings.limits: Diagnostic API only; no exact-certificate or authority promotion asserted.

findings.title: CheckedPacket compares witness values without binding their carrier identities
findings.detail: new_checked compares trichotomy.phi1_value to verified_phi1.value only, then copies arbitrary nonzero certificate refs and caller carrier/boundary/weights/defect hashes. Equal values from unrelated presentations can populate one apparently checked packet. Require source/certificate bindings or document and encode an explicit trusted admission layer that establishes them.
findings.limits: Sealed result retains FactOnly and later certificate retains None; no runtime authority exploit claimed. Parent core_policy review may supply additional downstream constraints.

findings.title: Weighted norm deserialization bypasses positive weights and evaluation admits nonfinite outputs
findings.status: reproduced by unchanged-source native probe in both overflow-check modes
findings.detail: Derived Deserialize accepts weights [-1] despite new rejecting them; evaluate([1]) then returns Ok(-1), contradicting norm nonnegativity. Even valid weights allow NaN input or finite overflow to Ok(NaN/inf). Route deserialization through constructor and validate evaluation coordinates/results.
findings.limits: Floating diagnostic API; no exact-certificate or authority exploit claimed.

findings.title: Residual constructor treats the Exact alias as a valid-rational seal
findings.status: reproduced by unchanged-source native probe in both overflow-check modes
findings.detail: Exact is a public BigRational alias and permits new_raw(1,0). Residual::new sends it into a guard returning None then unreachable!, producing a panic instead of a typed refusal. Provide checked construction or a genuinely sealed exact scalar.
findings.limits: Native constructor; valid wire parsing follows a separate guarded path. No forged residual or authority claim.

findings.title: Public splitting parameter constructor can panic when basis width exceeds ambient dimension
findings.status: reproduced by unchanged-source native probe in both overflow-check modes
findings.detail: For m=1,r=2 it sets s=m-min(r,m)=0 and admits all listed shapes, then slices inverse[..r] although inverse length=m. Main certificate verify separately rejects r>m, but direct exported Result API does not. Check r<=m before slicing.
findings.limits: Malformed native helper input; not a forged verified splitting.

findings.title: Observer gauge objects do not preserve the positive finite weight premise
findings.status: reproduced by unchanged-source native probe in both overflow-check modes
findings.detail: Public/Deserialize weights allow negative/nonfinite values bypassing ScalarGauge::new; VectorGauge and TraceGauge have no constructor gate. All evaluations only compare outer lengths, so purported gauge can return negative or nonfinite values. Seal/validate weights and arithmetic, and treat supplied singular values as an explicitly unverified adapter input.
findings.limits: Representative diagnostics only. General CPTP maps contract trace distance; the source CPTP-invariant phrase is not established by this implementation.

findings.title: Bianchi and rational observer evaluators omit invalid-rational admission

Phi3 certificate verifier and Phi4 curvature evaluator have denominator checks, so behavior is inconsistent across neighboring entry points. Validate all consumed scalar families before arithmetic.

findings.title: Phi4 test labels a fabricated zero-map complex as the boundary of a5-simplex
findings.detail: simplex5_boundary_complex claims S4, but assigns all-zero d0/d1/d2 and manufactures d3 columns by tet%6. With d0=0 and six vertices its H0 dimension is6, not connected S4. The sole acceptance test uses all-zero flux/residual/dual, so it does not demonstrate a nonzero4-cavity obstruction or actual simplicial boundary. Rename as synthetic chain or replace with true oriented incidence and independent nonzero witness tests.
findings.limits: The generic quotient checker may be correct for the synthetic matrix; the defect is the topology/test-evidence claim, not proven false native arithmetic.
